title: Ok sheets
text:
Ok sheets. These sheets are pretty good. I would think they should last a little while. I was disappointed to see the flat sheet did not have the same edge design as the pillow cases.
I also agree with the person who said they were considering sewing the inner flap down on the cases.. that's a poor design.
However they do fit my bed nice and the flat sheet is nice and long for tucking in.
I ordered 2 full size and one queen set. For the price I feel it's a fair value.
